paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change across layers of a model, likely in response to some modification. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents layer numbers from 1 to 32, divided into four segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale ranging from -25% to +5%, and includes tick marks at -20%, -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, 5% and 10%. A gray dashed line represents 0%. A blue line with circular markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1 and descends to a minimum value of -16% at Layer 13, before rising to a value of -2% at Layer 28, and ending at -3% at Layer 32. An orange line with triangular markers begins at approximately 1% at Layer 1, declines to -5% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and ends at 1% at Layer 32. A red line with square markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1, declines to -6% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and terminates at 1% at Layer 32. Finally, a gray dashed line represents a baseline, starting and ending at 0% across the entire x-axis range.
